chapter.heading: Bildad’s Third Response to Job
chapter.v:
“God is
powerful and dreadful.He enforces peace in the heavens.

Who is
able to count his heavenly army? Doesn’t his light shine on all the earth?

How can
a mortal be innocent before God? Can anyone born of a woman be pure?

God is
more glorious than the moon;he shines brighter than the stars.

In comparison,
people are maggots;we mortals are mere worms.”
